scripts.test: pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:backend
scripts.eval:stage3c:acceptance: uv run --directory apps/api pytest tests/evaluation/stage3c/session tests/evaluation/stage3c/acceptance tests/test_execution.py tests/test_execution_harness.py -q && pnpm --filter @counterq/web test -- curated-interview-room.test.tsx execution-panel.test.tsx interview-room.test.tsx realtime-voice.test.tsx
scripts.eval:stage3d:integrity: uv run --directory apps/api pytest tests/evaluation/stage3d/integrity tests/test_execution.py -q
scripts.eval:stage4b:behavior: uv run --directory apps/api pytest tests/evaluation/stage4 tests/evaluation/stage4b tests/test_ai_gateway.py -q
scripts.eval:stage5: uv run --directory apps/api pytest tests/evaluation/stage5 tests/test_stage5b_evidence_engine.py -q
scripts.eval:stage6a: uv run --directory apps/api pytest tests/evaluation/stage6a tests/test_stage6a_assistance.py -q
scripts.eval:stage6b: uv run --directory apps/api pytest tests/evaluation/stage6b tests/test_stage6b_session_reports.py tests/test_stage6b_p1_outbox.py tests/test_stage6b_p1_zero_finding.py -q
scripts.eval:stage7: uv run --directory apps/api pytest tests/evaluation/stage7 tests/test_stage7a_countermap.py -q
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run lint:backend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:frontend && pnpm run typecheck:backend
scripts.typecheck:backend: uv run --directory apps/api mypy app tests
scripts.contracts: pnpm run contracts:openapi && pnpm run contracts:generate
scripts.migrate: uv run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
